question: Will Chinese authorities approve imports of Nvidia H200 chips by Chinese firms by 2027-01-31, as shown by official Chinese government decisions or announcements?
rungs: rung 1 Yes: On or before 2027-01-31 Chinese authorities have officially approved imports of H200 chips by at least one Chinese firm.

rung 2 Ruled out: An official Chinese refusal of the requests to import H200 chips, or a prohibition of the imports, issued after 2026-07-08, stands on 2027-01-31 with no firm approved. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole taken after 2026-07-08, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole after that day, stands on 2027-01-31, and only when rung 1 does not.
rung 3 Still open: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2027-01-31.
